attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names neither member, so it is one folder for the pair. They are not `two-martyrs-in-phrygia`, `two-martyrs-of-parium` or `two-martyrs-mother-and-daughter`: these two are from Cyprus and died by the burning of their feet. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
